strategic_choice: ONE as accuracy-directed joint hard-member/hard-ensemble supervision with an online same-run teacher; TabM own-loss training is the simpler teacher-free reference. This is a prioritization judgment, not published dominance.
transferable_reason: Private true-label prediction errors remain supervised even when a committee is confident; shared representation remains live. Conditional architecture-independent learning-signal rationale, not universal quality guarantee.
graphs_may_violate: Competent branches can obtain distinct useful evidence from the common representation, and their committee supplies a reliable correction. Common missing/aliased evidence or a strict shared wrong rival defeats positive convex pooling; scarce correlated graph labels can also make own-loss fitting nonpredictive.
complete_history_limit: Both unavailable alternatives and available alternatives lost in pooling occur; saved majority-present finding rules out universal missing-evidence diagnosis.
